title: Survival Analysis of Knowledge Re-Emergence After Unlearning

original_idea.body:
# Survival Analysis of Knowledge Re-Emergence After Unlearning

**Problem:** We lack a way to quantify how durable an unlearning method is vs adversarial relearning budget.

**Direction:** Estimate a Kaplan-Meier survival curve for knowledge persistence and compare hazard rates across two methods on WMDP/TOFU.

**Why it matters:** Gives unlearning a durability metric. Targets dangerous-knowledge.

**Relevant context:** arXiv:2505.16831; arXiv:2510.02712; arXiv:2501.04952.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Durability metric for unlearning targets the dangerous-knowledge pathway recognized as critical; intermediate metric independently valuable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: WMDP/TOFU setups plus small relearning fine-tunes and KM curves; guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused survival-curve; depends on unlearning setup and relearning fine-tunes.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Neglected long-horizon dangerous-knowledge auditing; no internal access, benefits from external scrutiny.

low_compute.reasoning: Unlearning plus tiny relearning fine-tunes on one GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Relearning attacks documented; survival-analysis durability framing may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Relearning reversal known; KM durability metric framing may be open.
